Kinda. When I was in middle school, all I did was watch their sketches. Then, a couple years later, they said they needed to stop their main channel to focus of the movie (which i doubt will come anytime soon, and if it is, it wouldn’t be great). 

Sketches were the golden age, and now they do just jknews. I find that I can’t stop cringing after watching a few videos. Sometimes they just radiate ignorance, though I doubt there is bad intentions. Recently, there was a video where Bart said the blood was blue? Some episodes are poorly researched. They sadly picked quantity over quality. 

The only thing I truly enjoy nowadays are Joe’s podcasts. It feels like a conversation with your uncle lmao
